info.name: MediCitas - Demo
info.description: Direct-service demo requests. Import the safe environment and follow postman/README.md (English) or README.es.md. Send one request at a time; stop on unexpected status or unresolved variables. Optional administration changes disposable data. Assertions describe expected results; this file is not evidence of a full-stack execution. No login endpoint or real secrets.

item.name: 01 - Clinic onboarding (optional)
item.description: Creates a separate clinic. Does not change Clinic 1 tokens or seeded variables. Use a unique identifier and username; initialPassword is local only.

item.name: RF1 - Create clinic and first administrator

request.description: Platform administrator only. Requires running users/Keycloak Admin API. Captures demoClinicId and bootstrapAdminId. 409 on duplicate active clinic; see contract for pending-bootstrap recovery.
Uses the clinic in admin.sj token; not demoClinicId.

item.name: 02 - Catalog
item.description: Read seeded catalog, then optionally create/update a separate demo service. Never retire the seeded booking service.

request.description: Global reference catalog; clinic administrator only.
Use unique serviceName. Captures demoServiceId, leaving seeded serviceId unchanged.
Requires the preceding creation; replacement fields are all required.

item.name: 03 - Users and professionals (optional)
item.description: Use admin.sj token. Create a disposable professional user, then register its profile. Do not run role/deactivation cleanup until finished.

request.description: Choose unique managedUsername. Captures managedUserId. After activation_unconfirmed use Location recovery described in API; do not repeat creation blindly.

Requires new active professional user. Fresh registration: 201; a claim-repair retry can return 200 (see contract). Captures demoProfessionalId. Obtain a fresh token before acting as that new professional.

item.name: RF4 - Assign demo service to demo professional

request.description: Optional. Requires both optional creations before cleanup. Specialties must match. Idempotent assignment; seeded booking association already exists.

item.name: 04 - Patients
item.description: Membership read exposes only patientId. Writes below use a new synthetic patient; they queue audit events but do not deliver them to logs_db yet.

request.description: Use unique patientIdentification. Captures demoPatientId, leaving seeded patientId unchanged.
Requires new demo patient. Null clears contact; omitted fields stay unchanged.

item.name: 05 - Schedule and availability
item.description: Use Clinic 1 seeds. Set dayFrom/dayTo in the clinic zone and rangeFrom/rangeTo as instants. Choose startsA and replacementStartsA from free future non-overlapping slots. Availability is not a reservation.

request.description: Inclusive range of at most 31 clinic-local dates; returns professionals/days with slots.

item.name: RF7 - Availability for professional and day

request.description: Pick startsA on dayFrom and a second free non-overlapping future replacementStartsA. Copy slots manually; no booking is automatic.

item.name: 06 - Booking 201 / 409 / 422 and lifecycle
item.description: Run once, in order. Requires a future free startsA on dayFrom, active seeded service/association, both valid patients, and a different free replacementStartsA. Keep startsA unchanged until after conflict/invalid-input calls. Sequential conflict demonstration is not the automated concurrency race.

request.description: Send once. Captures appointmentAId only after 201. No Idempotency-Key support; never retry to recover an ID.
Same dayFrom/professional/service as before. With no other writers, startsA must now be absent.

exec: pm.test("Booked start removed", () => { const start = Date.parse(pm.environment.get("startsA")); pm.expect(Number.isFinite(start)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(pm.response.json().slots.some(s => Date.parse(s.startsAt) === start)).to.eql(false); });

request.description: After A=201, before reschedule/cancel, while startsA remains future. conflictPatientId must be a different valid patient with no overlapping booking, isolating the professional constraint.
Strict booking schema rejects client durationMinutes before dependency calls. Requires valid receptionist Bearer; duration always comes from catalog.
A must still be booked and future; replacement slot must be free. Old A becomes rescheduled. Continue with replacementAId.
Replacement must still be booked and future. Final state; cannot later become attended.
Run only after successful cancellation; confirms final-state rejection.
With no other writers, the original startsA should reappear after rescheduling/cancellation, provided it is still future.

exec: pm.test("Original start available again", () => { const start = Date.parse(pm.environment.get("startsA")); pm.expect(Number.isFinite(start)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(pm.response.json().slots.some(s => Date.parse(s.startsAt) === start)).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 07 - Started appointment and clinical note (separate)
item.description: Uses startedAppointmentId, not A or its cancelled replacement. Seed 804 is booked for dr.mora on 2026-11-12. Inspect current state first; this sequence runs only once per prepared appointment. Stop if already final or a note already exists. Note events remain in outbox until N10 is implemented.

request.description: Only after verified booked, startsAt <= now, and own professional. Before start: 422 appointment_not_started; final state: 409 invalid_transition.
Requires attended appointment owned by dr.mora and no existing note. 409 note_exists on repeat. Produces AuditRecorded in appointments outbox.
Only its professional can read the note; successful read also queues AuditRecorded.

item.name: 08 - Operational queries
item.description: Read current Clinic 1 data. rangeFrom/rangeTo filter appointment starts for counts; date is clinic-local for agenda. No clinical note/contact text in these responses.

item.name: 09 - Audit and authorization
item.description: Audit query is clinic_admin only. Seeded audit rows are readable, but do not demonstrate delivery of new note/contact events: N10 audit relay is still pending. Use event-time range and domain auditUserId, not Keycloak sub.

request.description: No authentication inherited or sent.
Needs valid unexpired receptionist token; expired/malformed tokens give 401 instead.
Returns all visible events; empty array is valid. No pagination.

item.name: RF19 - Filter by user, patient and event time

request.description: All filters combine with AND; occurredAt in [from,to). Choose a range covering seed events for a nonempty result; [] is valid.

item.name: 90 - Administration cleanup (optional, run last)
item.description: Only resources created by this collection. Role change invalidates the demo user sessions; seeded admin.sj is the caller. Logical retirement/deactivation, not deletion of history.

request.description: Only demoServiceId, never seeded serviceId.
Only managedUserId from creation. Requires an active demo user.
Only managedUserId. Logical deactivation. Do not target seeded actors.
